notes.title: 1.1.0 - Beta
notes.content:
Custom Campaigns
- Upload your own custom campaign to the workshop
- Your own medals, unlockable levels, time and progression

Available in the beta branch.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33507207/48eebe974219e72aca9c971176455e9dbdc33861.png[/img]

Builder:
- Users can modify their levels on the workshop.
- Versioning levels
- Workshop ui breaks on incomplete data when another user uploads a new level.
- Warning when user wants to close the game but has unsaved changes.
- Fixing disabled mouse in first level on PC when dialog is present
- If you place a container into a container it's containing, the program crashes.
- Disable workshop ui when steam is not running.
- Prompt user before he deletes a level.
- Delete level icon moved to level settings, this makes it hard to accidentally press.
- Level is saved automatically before its uploaded to workshop.
- Option to flip the curve in curve editor.
- Exposing properties for vacuum enemy.
- Ability to toggle colliders.
- Level creator shown in the workshop ui card.
- Overall fixes and dialogs, progress bars.
- Issues with decimals on non US locales.
- Fixing adding multiple dynamic components breaking
- Support for copy and pasting geometry between levels

New Features:
- Community maps.
- Cone enemy.
- Fan enemy.
- Skins.

Fixes:
- Players in coop bumps a little on impact.
- Screens are colored in split-screen.
- Disabling falling auto-kill when ball is in invincible zone.
- Fixing finish checkpoint in Brown A that extends beyond floor.
- Z-fighting issues.
- Support for native monitor resolution on pc.
- Fixing graphic issues with 3 player split-screen.
- Balls are controllable after the game is finished in race mode multi-player.
- Fixing balls spawning outside map in multi-player.
- Various collision issues in levels.(edited)
